result:
Implementation complete. Summary of what was added for the milestones feature:

**Types & schemas**: `MilestoneId` (common.ts), `src/types/milestone.ts` (`Milestone`, `MilestoneProgress`, `MilestoneWithProgress`), `milestoneId` on `Issue`, three `milestone.*` events on `TaskflowEventMap`, `milestone.*` audit actions + `milestone` subject kind, `issue_milestone_changed` notification kind, `src/schemas/milestone.ts`, `milestoneIdSchema`, `milestoneId` on `createIssueSchema`.

**Domain errors**: `src/lib/milestones.ts` (`MilestoneStateError`), wired into `toAppError`/`isDomainError`.

**Persistence**: new `milestones` table + `issues.milestone_id` column (schema file + `migrate.ts` fallback SQL), `milestone-repository.ts`, `_mappers.ts` updates.

**Services**: `src/server/services/milestone-service.ts` (create/update/close/reopen/list/get, with the open-milestone cap, case/trim-insensitive name uniqueness, listing order, and overdue computation), `issue-service.ts` gained `setIssueMilestone` and milestone validation on `createIssue`. Wired the close-triggered issue hand-off, audit logging (`activity-service.ts`), and notification fan-out (`notification-service.ts`).

**Tests**: updated existing `Issue`-shaped fixtures (`tests/helpers/factories.ts`, `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`, `board-model.test.ts`, `optimistic-issues.test.ts`) to carry the new field so they keep type-checking.

Verified with `tsc --noEmit`, `eslint .`, the full `vitest` suite (617 passing), and ad-hoc smoke scripts exercising the cap, name collisions, close/reopen transitions, cross-project guards, and the notification/audit fan-out end-to-end against a real SQLite db.
